name: Ismene Circe
source:
A Nepo baby to the extreme, she was basically guaranteed to birth but still insists she worked hard to get where she is now. Admittedly she DOES have a lot of classics papers released and her academic interpretations of ancient Greek literature has been revolutionary in the field but I still don't have to respect her.

She's a rather blunt no-nonsense girl who knows just how smart she is and doesn't attempt to coddle or baby the other prisoners, her inflated sense of self would make it seem like she was just being patronizing if she tried, Despite her attitude, she seems attached to certain prisoners despite her judgmental nature although they seem a little off put by her occasionally morbid jokes.

She not only believes she did nothing wrong when it comes to her crime but firmly believes she actively did the right thing. When we mentioned Kota she seemed to falter on this stance. Further investigation needed.

[From the [url=https://danganronpa-fanganprojects.fandom.com/wiki/Ismene_Circe_(Danganronpa_Antebellum:_LOCKDOWN)]Wiki[/url]]
